map.输入基期与报告期的材料、人工、机械价格及权重，计算各项造价指数与综合造价指数涨跌: Enter base-period and report-period prices and weights for materials, labor, and machinery to compute each cost index and the composite cost index change.
map.单项指数 Iᵢ 为报告期价 P₁ᵢ 与基期价 P₀ᵢ 之比；综合造价指数按各费用: A single-item index Iᵢ is the ratio of report-period price P₁ᵢ to base-period price P₀ᵢ; the composite cost index is weighted by each cost item's weight wᵢ, and the change = composite index − 100 (%), with weights ideally summing to 100%.
map.💡 公式：单项指数 Iᵢ = P₁ᵢ/P₀ᵢ×100；综合造价指数 = Σ(Iᵢ: 💡 Formula: single index Iᵢ = P₁ᵢ/P₀ᵢ×100; composite cost index = Σ(Iᵢ×wᵢ)/Σwᵢ; change = composite − 100 (%). Weights are each cost share; the three should ideally sum to 100%.
map.权重之和不必严格为100%，系统自动按实际权重加权: The weight sum need not be exactly 100%; the system auto-weights by actual weights.
map.基期价与报告期价需为同期同类可比价格: Base and report prices must be comparable same-period, same-type prices.
map.指数>100表示造价上涨，<100表示下降: Index > 100 means cost up; < 100 means down.
map.📚 深度解析：工程造价指数计算（材料/人工/机械加权）: 📚 Deep Dive: Construction Cost Index (material / labor / machinery weighting)
map.造价动态管理：输入基期与报告期的人材机价格与权重，算综合指数: Dynamic cost management: enter base and report man-material-machine prices and weights to compute the composite index.
map.涨跌分析：分解各组分对总指数的贡献: Change analysis: decompose each component's contribution to the total index.
map.结算调差：指数用于合同价动态调整: Settlement adjustment: the index is used for contract-price dynamic adjustment.
map.算法：单项指数 = 报告期价/基期价×100；综合指数 = Σ(单项指数×权重): Algorithm: single index = report price / base price × 100; composite index = Σ(single index × weight) / Σweight; change = composite − 100; each component contribution = (single index − 100) × weight / total weight.
map.例：材料基 5000→报告 5800（权 55）、人工 200→230（权 25: Example: material base 5000→report 5800 (weight 55), labor 200→230 (weight 25), machinery 800→880 (weight 20) → material index 116, labor 115, machinery 110, composite 114.55 (up 14.55%); material contribution +8.8, labor +3.75, machinery +2.0, dominated by material price rise.
map.按预算中人材机费用占比定；不同工程（土建/安装）权重差异大，须用实际造价构成。: Set by the man-material-machine cost share in the budget; different works (civil / installation) differ greatly and must use the actual cost structure.
map.指数涨 14.55% 意味什么？: What does a 14.55% index rise mean?
map.同口径工程比基期贵 14.55%，合同若含调差条款可按此调价；须明确基期与报告期: A same-basis project is 14.55% more expensive than base; if the contract has an adjustment clause, reprice by this; keep base and report bases consistent.
map.关于「工程造价指数计算」: About the Construction Cost Index Calculator
map.工程造价指数计算器，基于材料、人工、机械三大费用要素的基期与报告期价格及权重，采: The construction cost index calculator, from base and report prices and weights of the three cost elements (material, labor, machinery), uses weighted averaging to compute the composite cost index and its change, aiding dynamic cost management.
